literal_anchor: a man vocalizing dismissive criticism toward a woman while gesturing demeaningly at her physical work project
selection_logic: The sentence establishes a belittling interpersonal act directed at someone's creative effort. A three-shot structure provides the complete causal progression without invented aftermath: shot one establishes the speaking action across the interpersonal axis; shot two isolates the specific physical manifestation of 'her work' being demeaned through careless physical handling; shot three registers her visible restraint under the derogatory impact. The opening two-shot sets the interpersonal baseline, while the second insert escalates the tactile disrespect, leading naturally to the heaviest visual weight on the third shot where the emotional sting of 'derogatory' lands fully.
